rule: donor_flat is the base scenario; stumpage_scaled is sensitivity
notes: The price method is unchanged from v2.1. v2.2 changes only cost inputs where direct public evidence exists.

rule: use MRNF 2022 T20 harvest, haul and road survey aggregates
notes: T20 before transfers; road gross; not T5 after-PRCCM. Survey aggregates, not observed transactions.

rule: low/high are the published regional SEPM minimum/maximum
notes: Seven regional means are used only for the range. R09 is a three-respondent mean and remains flagged in the source.

rule: do not combine T5 after-PRCCM road with T10 transfers
notes: T20 road is access_cost_gross. The T5 after-PRCCM total is not used because T10 transfers already include the rebate.

rule: use published IAM 2026 road-maintenance CAD/m3 allowance
notes: Low/base/high are the minimum/median/maximum of 22 published road maintenance groups. Appraisal allowance, not observed cost.

rule: do not convert road construction CAD/km or CAD/each to CAD/m3
notes: The allowance covers road maintenance only. It is not a full road construction/amortization value and does not establish full direct BC road coverage.

rule: keep donor costs and record missing direct cost series
notes: No direct public logging, haul, road or silviculture cost series is materialised for Alberta or Ontario. No fake value is inserted.

rule: keep donor costs where no direct series is materialised
notes: No value is invented for jurisdictions without direct cost data.

rule: price proxy - logging - haul - road - silviculture
notes: Low uses high cost; high uses low cost.

rule: negative margins are retained and labelled
volume-weight provincial margins by the 119 Mt allocation

notes: Reported survey aggregates and appraisal allowances are model inputs, not observed transactions.

rule: no deflator applied between 2025 BC price, 2022 QC costs and 2026 allowances
notes: Nominal mismatch is explicit and not corrected.

rule: dues/stumpage rates are not delivered prices
notes: Stumpage, dues, royalty and standing-value rates are charges on standing timber. They are not delivered log prices: a delivered price embeds harvest, haul, road and silviculture cost plus a margin. Subtracting the same cost stack from a scaled dues rate double counts those costs if the result is read as a mill margin. Rates also differ in unit, species/grade, tenure, scaling and vintage. Deltas are therefore method changes, not observed market changes.
